stem_book: A uniform rod of length 1.5 m and mass 3 kg is hinged at one end and can rotate freely in a vertical plane. The rod is initially held horizontal and then released. Find the initial angular acceleration of the rod. (Given: moment of inertia of rod about hinge = mℓ²/3, g = 9.8 m/s²) (a) 9.8 rad/s² (b) 4.9 rad/s² (c) 8.9 rad/s² (d) 9.4 rad/s²
reason: Coordinator: printed 'vertically upright' changed to horizontal to fit the key - not used. Print says 'held vertically upright' — then the weight's torque about the hinge is zero and α = 0 (no option). Printed key (a) 9.8 = 3g/(2ℓ) exactly, i.e. the horizontal release of twin Q4; stem corrected to 'held horizontal'.
